headline: The Clean Girl Gift Guide (For the Girl Who Wakes Up Like This)
description: A clean girl gift guide for the glowy, gold-hoop, matcha-sipping girl on your list: skincare, lip mask, hair oil, and the finishing touches. Aesthetic, giftable, and chic.

headline: Gifts for 5-Year-Old Girls: Wait, They Make THIS?!
description: Gifts for 5-year-old girls that make even grown women say 'wait, they make this?!' Eight unusual, show-stopping ideas, ranked with sarcasm and zero crayons.

headline: Gifts for 8-10 Year Old Girls (She Is Not a Baby, Thank You)
description: Gifts for 8 to 10 year old girls that are anything but babyish: an instant camera, a Tamagotchi, a Stanley, a doll with a whole personality, and more.

headline: Gifts for Women in Their 20s (Who Say "I Don't Need Anything" and Absolutely Do)
description: Gifts for women in their 20s that feel like a treat: a cloud-soft throw, an instant camera, a sunrise alarm, a Kindle, and more. Chic, useful, and not another candle.

headline: Host & Hostess Gifts (Because Wine Is Not a Personality, Darling)
description: Host and hostess gifts that go way beyond a bottle of wine: a champagne saber, a cocktail smoker, a truffle oil duo, a bitters trio and more. Elegant, giftable and not another candle.
